g.text: Panel: J1 CLOCK IN, J2 FREEZE IN, J5 CLOCK OUT = JST PH to jack (1 tip, 2 GND); J3, J4 = JST PH to a button.

g.desc: Panel: J1 CLOCK IN, J2 FREEZE IN, J5 CLOCK OUT = JST PH to jack (1 tip, 2 GND); J3, J4 = JST PH to a button.

g.text: gate-io-direct (D62): gates straight on GPIO. In: 100k -> NPN, 10k to +3V3, 1N4148 base clamp (EuroPi); the pin reads LOW while the gate is high.

g.desc: gate-io-direct (D62): gates straight on GPIO. In: 100k -> NPN, 10k to +3V3, 1N4148 base clamp (EuroPi); the pin reads LOW while the gate is high.

g.text: A button across each transistor (J3 TAP, J4 FREEZE) gives the same edge by hand. Out: buffer on +5V, 1k: 0/5 V; 10k holds it low in reset.

g.desc: A button across each transistor (J3 TAP, J4 FREEZE) gives the same edge by hand. Out: buffer on +5V, 1k: 0/5 V; 10k holds it low in reset.
